assumptions: Cross-regime continuity is semantic and commitment-based; representative micro/molecular/atomic states are bounded local materializations rather than whole-object enumeration.
Source coordinate units are explicit and non-fm structural coordinates are accepted only through exact conversion to integer femtometres with source-space provenance retained.
limitations: Material component ppm is never reinterpreted as mole fraction.
Reaction networks are topology descriptors only; kinetics and thermodynamics are not solved.
Source-backed structure requires explicit provenance and licensing metadata before V2X-12 treats the source claim as eligible.
Computed structural coordinates remain model-derived and never inherit source-backed experimental authority.
No molecular dynamics, reactive molecular dynamics, electron-orbit, orbital, wavefunction or quantum-dynamics claim is made.

fidelity.validity: Bounded source-aware material, tissue/cell organization, representative microstructure, chemistry topology and atomic structural continuity layered over shipping v1 matter providers.
fidelity.resolution: Tissue/cell descriptor bridge plus MATERIAL, MICROSTRUCTURE, MOLECULAR and ATOMIC semantic regimes with explicit finite caps and fail-closed source-unit conversion.
fidelity.uncertainty: Unknown chemistry, unsupported source provenance, unmeasured kinetics and non-classical states remain explicitly unresolved or unsupported.

assumptions: Semantic magnification and normalized display coordinates can communicate regime changes without asserting literal Euclidean zoom or new scientific authority.
Cell compartments, membranes, gradients, transport capacities and material-flow topology can be exposed as bounded semantic cues without claiming literal morphology, flux rates or metabolic kinetics.
Reducing a rendering budget must not reposition retained nodes; bounded omission is reported explicitly with available-count and truncation witnesses.
limitations: Material, molecular and biological compartment placement is presentation-only.
Microstructure phases, interfaces and defects plus mixture, bond and reaction relations are semantic cues rather than simulated geometry or dynamics.
Fixed-point structural coordinates are centered and normalized for display while original integer coordinates, source-space coordinates and units remain separately retained.
Computed atomic structure is explicitly distinguished from source-backed experimental structure.
Node and relation budgets can omit otherwise available bounded cues; omission is exposed through truncation witnesses and is never presented as a complete inventory.
The provider owns no shared camera, scale, selection, input or canonical mutation authority.

fidelity.validity: Authority-labelled bounded presentation spanning provider-supported cell organization, material composition, microstructure descriptors, molecular topology and atomic structures.
fidelity.resolution: At most 256 provider nodes and 128 semantic relations per projected representation, with stable retained-node placement and explicit truncation witnesses.
fidelity.uncertainty: Source-backed, computed/model-derived, unresolved, presentation-only and budget-truncated states remain distinguishable; no visualization upgrades model authority.
